# Verification traceability

These selectors name the required test and evidence for each contract. PARTIAL and EXTERNAL GATE entries retain coverage gaps. Passing a selector check establishes structural coverage. Execution requires independent evidence as specified in [ACO_SPEC.md](../../../ACO_SPEC.md).
